title: HAKIMI: THREE GOALS, TWO ASSISTS, AND HE IS A DEFENDER
description:
135 league games, never more than two goal contributions. Then came Le Havre.

PSG beat Le Havre 5-1, and Hakimi was involved in all five goals. Three goals, two assists, his first career hat-trick. He is the only defender with five goal contributions in a Ligue 1 game.

The same night, Luis Enrique won his 127th game as PSG coach, which passed Laurent Blanc for the club record.

Hakimi finished 13th in the 2026 Ballon d'Or, 16 places above Sadio Mane. He is the favourite for the CAF award in Lagos on 7 December. Strikers, look nervous.

Does Hakimi deserve the CAF award? Yes or no, and why?
